{
  "name": "hortivitalmix",
  "private": true,
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "type": "module",
  "engines": {
    "node": "24.x"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "vite --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000",
    "build": "npm run typecheck && npm run security:check && vite build && node --import tsx scripts/check-bundle.ts",
    "preview": "vite preview --host 0.0.0.0",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "lint": "npm run typecheck && npm run security:check",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "test:integration": "HVM_INTEGRATION_ENABLED=true vitest run tests/integration",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "security:check": "node --import tsx scripts/security-check.ts",
    "preflight": "node --import tsx scripts/preflight.ts",
    "verify": "npm run typecheck && npm test",
    "verify:foundation": "node --import tsx scripts/verify-foundation.ts",
    "release:current": "node --import tsx scripts/release-current.ts",
    "verify:deploy": "node --import tsx scripts/verify-deploy.ts",
    "homologate": "node --import tsx scripts/require-integration.ts && npm run preflight && npm run migrations:verify && npm run verify && npm run build && npm run verify:foundation && npm run test:e2e",
    "migrations:verify": "node --import tsx scripts/migrations-manifest.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@supabase/supabase-js": "2.116.0",
    "dotenv": "18.0.1",
    "express": "4.21.2",
    "lucide-react": "1.47.0",
    "pg": "8.23.0",
    "react": "19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "zod": "4.6.5"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@playwright/test": "1.63.0",
    "@sparticuz/chromium": "153.0.0",
    "@types/express": "4.17.25",
    "@types/node": "26.6.2",
    "@types/pg": "8.23.1",
    "@types/react": "19.3.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "@types/supertest": "7.2.1",
    "@vitejs/plugin-react": "6.1.1",
    "agent-browser": "0.38.1",
    "prettier": "3.9.8",
    "supabase": "2.117.0",
    "supertest": "7.2.2",
    "tsx": "4.23.13",
    "typescript": "7.0.2",
    "vite": "8.3.0",
    "vitest": "5.0.1"
  }
}
